info.text:
Amazon spent nearly $103B on shipping in one year (2025). So who pays for free shipping?
Amazon's shipping costs rose from $76.7B in 2021 to $102.7B in 2025, per its 10-K.
Target and Walmart set a $35 free-shipping minimum for most non-members (Target also waives it for Circle Card holders).
Prime costs $139 a year and Walmart+ $98 a year (US prices as of late 2026).
Our math: topping a $28 cart up to $35 is $7, or 25%, more spending.
Amazon's 10-K counts shipping in cost of sales, so it's built into prices overall.
Sources: Amazon Form 10-K filings 2021-2025, Target and Walmart shipping policies.
News and education, not financial advice.
